summary: Iteration 48 — Verified City Landing Pages (/api/site/cities, /api/site/city/{slug}) and dynamic OG image (/api/site/og-image) + sitemap. All 6 backend pytest tests pass; frontend /city/patna, /city/ranchi, /city/unknown-city, homepage OG meta, footer 'Cities we serve' column, and mobile 390px overflow-free all pass. No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: og_image_service.og_image_png() caches only the base64-encoded PNG (10-min TTL) keyed on `site:og-image`. Since the composition depends on branding.logo_light + theme.primary + seo.meta_description, ensure cache_service.bust_prefix('site:') is called when admin saves Branding & Theme / SEO — otherwise share previews stay stale up to 10 minutes.

city_service._city_page issues a full scan of services + bookings (up to 20000) per request. For hotter cities the current 60s cache is fine, but the fan-out per partner_id / category_id is O(n²) at scale; consider precomputing partner job counts in a bookings.aggregate pipeline.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seed: Patna 6 partners / 2 completed / 1 review; Ranchi 1 partner / 0 jobs)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_city_and_og.py (uses timeout=60 to survive cold cache).
